cards.name: Platinum Exclusive

rules.name: Special categories
rules.conditions: supermarkets, telecom, fuel, education, government, charities, transport, rentals, insurance and fast food earn 1 pt per AED

cards.notes: Earn: 2.5 pts per AED in the UAE (about 0.88%), 3.5 pts on non-AED spend, 1 pt in special categories; cap 999,999 pts/month. Merchant category is whatever the merchant registered, so mis-categorised spend cannot be disputed. Fees, minimum salary and welcome offers were NOT obtained: NBF's card pages carry no figures and the Key Facts Statement PDF could not be opened in this environment, so they are null. Rewards programme started 11 Feb 2025; spend through NBF Direct app/online banking earns no points. Point value from NBF rewards page: 1 point = AED 0.0035.
